title: atlas(#5670 §8): verify aggregator absorption of embed_pass3.py / embed_onnx.py / atlas-ingest.py; retire outside copies

labels.name: task/small-fix
labels.description: Queue packet kind: bounded fix with reproduction and targeted tests

body:
Slice of #5670 (§8 of the Scaler-era data architecture revision, design PR #5667). Phase 1 (Python reference + eval corpus) is landed and parity-verified — see the phase-1 record linked from #5670.

**Row:** `hatch-personal/workspace/turso-atlas/scripts/embed_pass3.py`, `embed_onnx.py`, `atlas-ingest.py` → absorbed by the §4.3 aggregator (`fleet serve` search role) embedding/promotion stages. No file copy: the destination is Rust aggregator behaviour, so this slice is a coverage verification, then retirement.

**Work:**
1. For each outside script, enumerate its functions (embedding passes ST + ONNX; publish/ingest into production atlas) and map each to the aggregator stage that replaces it (`pkgs/atlas-search` stage/aggregator code, `fleet serve` search role). Record the mapping on this issue.
2. Any function with no aggregator counterpart is a gap: file it as its own issue and link it here; do not retire that script yet.
3. When coverage is complete, mark the three outside copies retired (header/README pointer in hatch-personal) and record the grep evidence on #5670.

Related ingestion programme: #6018, #7969, #9097 — coordinate rather than duplicate.

**Acceptance:** a per-script coverage table recorded here; gaps filed as linked issues; covered scripts marked retired outside; #5670 updated.
